messages:
incidentbot: PAGING: PagerDuty incident INC-12345 fired for service=\"inference-gateway\" in eu-west-1 — symptom=5xx spike. Auto-assign attempted. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC-12345

sam: Acked — I'm taking this. Opening bridge now.

oncall-rotation: Reminder: please follow the on-call handoff protocol if this goes >30m. Primary is sam, secondary is kevin.

incidentbot: Incident INC-12345 acknowledged by sam. Responders: sam, kevin.

kevin: Joining bridge. I'll start looking at proxy logs and autoscaler events.

sam: quick check: grafana shows a sharp increase in 502/503s starting 12:02 UTC, peaked ~12:06. Correlates with a burst of new pods in ded-pool-3. Suspecting model-proxy overload during cold starts.

priya: @maria any customer tickets? I saw one Flowlo support ping ~12:05. Need customer-impact estimate.

maria: Confirmed — Flowlo reported repeated generation failures around 12:04-12:08 UTC. Telemetry: ~8% of requests errored in eu-west-1 window. No billing impact flagged yet; customers seeing transient failures.

sam: putting quick mitigation: scaling ded-pool-3 from 6 -> 12, and rolling back model-proxy to v2.0 (recent v2.1 deploy at 11:58 might be contributing). Executing now:
```bash
# scale
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/ded-pool-3 --replicas=12
# rollback proxy
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/model-proxy --to-revision=42
```

incidentbot: Autoscaling action recorded; rollout undo triggered by sam.

kevin: tailing proxy logs — seeing repeated timeout and OOM logs on a subset of pods. After scale & rollback, new pods are warm-starting.

sam: early signal: 5xx down to ~2% in the last minute. Still watching. Keeping bridge open. :eyes:

priya: Thanks — preparing a short customer update to Flowlo support: \"We're investigating a transient 5xx spike in eu-west-1; mitigation in progress; will follow up when fully resolved.\" Anyone want to add details?

maria: Add that we've rolled back the recent model-proxy deploy and scaled pool as an immediate mitigation. ETA to fully recover: ~10-15m.

kevin: adding run command used for trace collection:
```text
kubectl logs model-proxy-abc123 -n inference --since=10m | grep -E \"ERROR|OOM|timeout\" | tail -n 50
```

sam: update: errors down to 0.4% over the last 5m. CPU on model-proxy normalized. Suggest we keep increased pool for 30m then scale down.

oncall-rotation: Noted. If no regression, handoff at 12:40 UTC is fine. Who will monitor post-handoff?

sam: I'll hand off to kevin at 12:40. kevin, you good to be primary monitor?

kevin: Yep, I'll monitor dashboards and alert on any re-raise. I'll also add a follow-up ticket to tune autoscaler backoff and probe readiness.

priya: I'll send the customer note to Flowlo support with the mitigation details now.

maria: Filing a brief post-incident note: root-cause hypothesis = model-proxy v2.1 + autoscaler interaction causing pod churn and cold-start overload. Will confirm after logs/heap dumps processed.

sam: handing off to kevin for active monitoring until 12:55 UTC. If error rate creeps above 1% page me. :+1:

incidentbot: Incident INC-12345 status updated: acknowledged -> monitoring. Assigned: kevin (monitor).

kevin: On it. Bridge will remain open for 30m; will post final update then.

sam: thanks all — closing my primary for this incident.

kevin: final (for now): baseline restored, customer notified, follow-up ticket created: INF-5678 (autoscaler backoff / readiness probes). Will do a retrospective entry. :memo:
